openings.claim: Capture nonworking margins using opposing contact stops, bolted strip guides and pivoting retaining straps on existing slots; release accessible tabs for gloved inspection. Replace magnetic/pad-friction dependency with mechanical capture. Drill strips only; plier-form four supplied strips, using supplied bolts and cork contacts.
openings.discriminator: Versus a magnet-assisted friction clamp, geometric capture should retain either plate despite different magnetic holding (7 N/3 N). Expect the spare within 1 mm with engaged stops and magnetic assistance absent. Hypothesis only: weaker pull alone does not predict stroke slip; fitness checks cannot exclude friction as the cause.
openings.probe: Measure slots, margins and clearance with ruler; sketch opposing stops/removal path. Proceed only if strips form and M4 bolts fit without carriage disassembly/forbidden modifications. Within eighty fabrication and twenty observation minutes, test one configuration: three twenty-stroke runs, spare last; three timed removal/return checks, thick gloves last. Mark position away from the working edge; handle nonworking margins only. Require every initial-position displacement within 1 mm and every check within sixty seconds; check returned position. Observe stop contact, bolt loosening and interference.
openings.uncertainty: Slot fit, stop geometry/travel, strip thickness/formability and resistance to unspecified stroke loads remain unknown. Opposing stops, top restraint and accessible gloved releases must fit outside clearance. Defeat: flexure, inadequate slot travel, inaccessible fasteners, interference or displacement/time failure. Abandon if unbuildable within resource caps.

lineage.reason: Protected relation, rival, tests, caveats and declared uncertain fit retained.

decision: Retain one unresolved probe candidate; no demonstrated performance or deployment claim. No drilling/cutting/heating/gluing plate or carriage; keep marked 30 mm edge exposed, added parts outside marked stroke clearance and carriage attached to rails. Supplied resources only; at most two configurations, three runs/checks each.
